items.title: David Montgomery: Status uncertain for Week 9
items.text:
Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that he has "no significant update" on the status of Montgomery (groin) heading into a Week 9 matchup with the Chargers, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Michael Pittman: Begins running, but lacks timetable
items.text:
Pittman (foot) said Monday that he resumed running last week as part of a program to return, but the wideout acknowledged that he's without a clear timeline to be activated from injured reserve, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Breece Hall: Expected back for Week 9
items.text:
Hall (quadriceps) is considered "good to go" and is expected to return to action in next Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: Receives assurances he won't be dealt
items.text:
Barkley said after Sunday's 27-10 loss to the Commanders that he has received assurances from the Eagles front office that he will remain with the team beyond the Nov. 10 trade deadline, Tim McManus of ESPN.com reports. "The whole time my mindset was, we have a little issue going on right now and I feel like I'm the type of player and the type of leader that can help us get out of it," Barkley said. "And I want to be one of the reasons why we fix it."

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tanner McKee: Fails to produce TD in Week 8 loss
items.text:
McKee completed 23 of 34 passes for 212 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 27-10 loss to the Commanders. He also rushed four times for 25 yards and lost a fumble.
